freeze_statement: This protocol is written before executing this audit. Existing Explorer examples and earlier integrity checks are already known; this is not a prospectively blinded scientific experiment.
objective: Check whether five concrete inspection tasks expose and preserve identical answers in the actual saved-evidence Explorer computation and a complete formatted-JSON baseline, against an independently implemented reader of the frozen original records.
population: All 18 published panels, every retained item and condition. Pair tasks enumerate every unordered pair of distinct conditions within an item and panel. No outcome-based exclusions or added predictions.

conditions.explorer: Import the published docs/explorer/core.mjs validatePanel, compare, comparisonExport and panelFrequencies functions without modification. Fields directly rendered from saved records are checked as record values, not falsely attributed to these functions.
conditions.formatted_json: Use precisely the same complete index and complete panel JSON, plus the complete selected comparison export. All probabilities, semantic keys, typed values, references, physical membership, provenance, model metadata, and full-panel summaries remain accessible. This is an information-equivalent JSON presentation, not an intentionally impoverished baseline.
conditions.independent_reference: Python standard-library reader resolves each ZIP member and one-based JSONL line; task answers are computed from archived semantic probabilities, typed values, source identities and full-panel source rows. It does not import the Explorer exporter or core functions.

outputs: continuous error or label match against the unchanged reference

tasks.unit: every saved condition and every pair export
outputs: original ZIP member and one-based line
exact semantic probabilities and typed value
complete physical member source definitions in the comparison export
Score expected-value range and population variance
tasks.interpretation: Report distributions without introducing a new threshold for collapse. These are descriptions of the frozen observations, not new model-quality results.

negative_controls: Recheck at least one actual pair with a deliberately false change flag, an incorrect shared-call union, and a false source line; the independent oracle must reject each corrupted task answer. Mutants exist only in memory and never alter source files.
outputs: results.json with task counts and failures
README.md with commands and scoped interpretation
ChainForge current-source scope assessment with pinned upstream URLs
prohibited_inferences: GUI functionality of ChainForge without running its GUI
